rules.name: 지형 소울 생성
tests: LP accumulates each turn and a land placement consumes LP only
terrain installation spends LP and the exact RequireSoul cost before adding production
terrain with insufficient install soul cannot consume LP or leave the hand
terrain LP is spent while its colored and neutral souls are added to the pool
terrain with an explicitly verified zero install-soul cost consumes LP and produces souls
fractional dual-colour production is preserved and deployment limit rounds down

rules.name: 지형 배치 횟수 규칙
tests: LP accumulates but only one land can be installed per preparation phase; field cap stays ten
rules.source_conflict: Manual summary says LP-count placements; ready.htm says one terrain per turn. Test confirms current engine behavior only, not source resolution.

rules.name: 무속성 유닛 소환 비용
tests: a generic neutral bead can be paid from any generated soul
colored and generic soul requirements consume a pool, not whole land cards
unit deployment spends colored soul and leaves unused soul in the pool
unit summon with insufficient colored soul leaves hand, field, and soul pool unchanged

rules.name: 무속성 유닛 유지 비용
tests: neutral soul upkeep is charged only for neutral summon beads
neutral upkeep is charged only for units with a neutral soul cost and limits deployment after upkeep

rules.name: 무속성 유지 비용 미지불
tests: unpaid neutral upkeep destroys exactly the missing number of deck cards

rules.name: 코인 기술 표기 및 계산
tests: FM1 unsigned 2C3 replaces the stat while +2C3 adds the same coin result
FM1 negative DP from coin subtraction is preserved

rules.name: 복수 능력치 코인 결과 공유
tests: FM1 shared coin toss is rolled once and reused for AP and DP

rules.name: 능력치 보호 기호
tests: stat markers block changes in the protected direction
DB29 Manual Skill1 stat effects respect per-stat marker directions

rules.name: 유닛 능력치 전투 의미
tests: unit slot combat is paired 1:1 with shared AP/DP/HP rolls and surviving HP resets after battle

rules.name: 아이템 장착 조건
tests: item attaches only to a unit with a matching native unit ability
item with unrestricted ability still requires matching native target race
item with unrestricted ability still requires matching native affiliation
unparsed native item target restrictions fail closed

rules.name: 준비 단계 진행 순서
tests: opening hand is six cards and contains at least one land for both sides
AI completes its preparation phase and yields to the player
a unit cannot be deployed more times than terrain-generated souls allow in one prep phase
FM1 reshuffle is available once per turn in the first four turns and burns one card
FM1 reshuffle is disabled after a card was placed and after turn four

rules.name: 전투 카드 처리 순서
tests: a spell is queued in its magic slot and resolves only in battle
battle-start spell timing is accepted for both sides
unit slot combat is paired 1:1 with shared AP/DP/HP rolls and surviving HP resets after battle

rules.name: 유닛의 덱 공격 피해량
tests: an unblocked unit attacks the deck using its printed soul cost
direct attack refuses to infer zero deck damage from an unverified empty summon cost

rules.name: 덱 소진 패배 조건
tests: both players running out of deck at once makes the attacker lose
